definitions.gloss: single steel pipe used for scaffolding and barriers
definitions.explanation: A standardized steel pipe, typically about 48 mm in diameter, used with clamps to build scaffolding, temporary fences, and simple structures at construction sites.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{単管|たんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: We carried steel pipes to the site.

examples.japanese: {単管|たんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦クランプ→クランプ：23997_kuranpu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つないで⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: We connect the steel pipes with clamps to build the scaffolding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事現場|こうじげんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まわり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{単管|たんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A temporary fence made of steel pipes stood around the construction site.

notes:
Short for {単管|たんかん}⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧. A construction-site term for the single steel tube used, with clamps (⟦クランプ→クランプ：23997_kuranpu⟧), to assemble scaffolding and temporary barriers. "{単|たん}" (single) distinguishes it from prefabricated frame units.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単管|たんかん}⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧: steel scaffolding pipe
- {単管|たんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to build scaffolding with steel pipe
- {単管|たんかん}バリケード: a barrier made of steel pipe
